title: Judge Blocks F.C.C. From Targeting Disney’s Local ABC Licenses
summary: A preliminary injunction halted an early regulatory review of the network’s operations in eight cities, including New York, Los Angeles and Chicago.
caption: ABC has borne the brunt of an attempt by the Federal Communications Commission to pressure the nation’s original broadcast networks over what it sees as liberal, anti-Trump bias.

title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Sours Holiday Plans for Tourists
summary: With a powerful storm bearing down on New York, the parade was postponed to Saturday, by which time many of the city’s visitors planned to be elsewhere.
caption: Throngs came to see character balloons for the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade be inflated on the Upper West Side of Manhattan, but impending weather prompted the rescheduling of the parade.
authors: Mack Liederman and Miles G. Cohen

title: The Thanksgiving Parade on Saturday. Can They Do That?
summary: After more than a century of tradition, the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade is suddenly flexible. Sure, this is fine.
caption: Even the half-inflated balloons turned melancholy at the prospect of delaying the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade.

title: Veruschka, One of the World’s First Supermodels, Has Died

title: Veruschka Was a Supermodel Before the Term Was Invented
summary: Her look made her a celebrity before models were known as celebrities.
